clauses.name: Definitions and Interpretation
clauses.text:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings set out below, and cognate expressions shall be construed accordingly:
(a) "Agreement" means this Agreement together with its schedules, annexures, written amendments, and other documents expressly incorporated by reference.
(b) "Effective Date" means 1 September 2026.
(c) "Services" means design, development, testing, deployment and twelve months of maintenance of a customer-facing ordering application.
(d) "Deliverables" means a working web application, its source code repository, deployment scripts, administrator documentation and two training sessions for operational staff.
(e) "Affiliate" means in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of an entity, or the power to direct its management and policies, whether through ownership of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise.
(f) "Applicable Law" means all statutes, enactments, ordinances, rules, regulations, notifications, circulars, guidelines, policies, directions, judgments, decrees, and orders of any Government Authority having the force of law in India, as in force from time to time and as amended, consolidated, re-enacted, or replaced.
(g) "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday, or a day declared to be a public holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 in the State in which this Agreement is executed, on which scheduled commercial banks are open for normal banking business in that State.
(h) "Force Majeure Event" means any event or circumstance beyond the reasonable control of the affected Party which prevents or materially impedes the performance of its obligations, including act of God, fire, flood, earthquake, cyclone, epidemic, pandemic, lockdown or other restriction imposed by order of a Government Authority, war, hostilities, act of terrorism, riot, civil commotion, strike or other industrial action not confined to the affected Party's own workforce, failure of public utilities or telecommunications infrastructure, and any change in Applicable Law that renders performance unlawful.
(i) "Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and continuing until this Agreement expires or is terminated in accordance with its terms.
(j) "Confidential Information" means all non-public, proprietary, commercially sensitive, technical, financial, business, strategic, operational, customer, vendor, and personnel information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party, in oral, written, visual, digital, or any other form, whether or not marked as confidential, which is designated as confidential or which by its nature ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential, together with all copies, notes, analyses, and derivative materials containing or derived from it.
A term defined in this clause bears that meaning wherever it appears in this Agreement in capitalised form, including in the recitals, the schedules, and any annexure, unless the context otherwise requires.

clauses.name: Relationship of Parties — Independent Contractors
clauses.text:
The Parties acknowledge and agree that the relationship created by this Agreement is that of independent contracting parties and not of employer and employee, partnership, joint venture, agency, or fiduciary relationship.
(a) neither Party shall hold itself out as having authority to bind the other, and neither Party shall incur any obligation, liability, or expense on behalf of the other, without that other Party's prior written authority
(b) each Party shall be solely responsible for the wages, statutory benefits, provident fund, gratuity, and social security contributions of its own personnel, and for its own taxes, duties, returns, and statutory filings arising in connection with this Agreement
(c) the personnel deployed by a Party shall at all times remain under that Party's direction, supervision, and control, and shall not be treated as employees or workmen of the other Party for the purposes of any labour, industrial, or social-security legislation
(d) each Party shall indemnify the other against any claim, demand, or proceeding brought by its own personnel, or by any authority on their behalf, which asserts an employment or engagement relationship with that other Party

clauses.text: Where a service, function or responsibility is not expressly described in this Agreement or in a Statement of Work but is reasonably necessary for the proper performance of the Services, it shall be treated as included within the Services and shall be performed at no additional charge, to the same extent and in the same manner as if it had been expressly described. A failure to give that notice before incurring the costs waives any claim to be paid for them.

clauses.name: Scope of Services
clauses.text:
The Service Provider shall provide the following services under this Agreement: Design, development, testing, deployment and twelve months of maintenance of a customer-facing ordering application.
The Service Provider shall perform the services with reasonable skill, care, and diligence, in accordance with the scope described above and with the standard of skill and care reasonably expected of a competent provider of comparable services. The following support, maintenance, or post-delivery obligations shall also apply: Bug fixes and security patches for twelve months from acceptance, with support available on working days between 9:00 a.m. And 6:00 p.m. The Parties acknowledge that the service scope is expected to culminate in the delivery of the outputs, work product, and reporting items expressly identified in this Agreement. The services shall be measured against the following acceptance, review, or completion standard: Each deliverable is accepted when it passes the agreed test cases in a staging environment and acceptance is confirmed in writing within ten working days of delivery. Any material expansion or variation of the service scope, timeline, or output expectations shall require prior written agreement between the Parties, including any corresponding commercial adjustment where applicable.

clauses.title: Audit, Information and Escalation
clauses.text: Each Party shall keep true and complete records of its performance under this Agreement, and shall preserve them for the period a law in force requires or for three (3) years from the end of the financial year to which they relate, whichever is longer. Audit rights shall operate as follows: Compliance may be audited once in any twelve-month period, on fifteen days' written notice, during business hours and at the auditing party's own cost. Information rights and periodic reporting shall operate as follows: Monthly management accounts within twenty-one days of month end, audited accounts within ninety days of the financial year end, and an annual budget before the year begins. Operational escalation shall follow this mechanism before formal remedies are invoked where commercially reasonable: 10. The following additional protection clauses shall also apply: A twelve-month non-solicitation of the disclosing party's employees and a prohibition on reverse engineering any disclosed prototype. Where this Agreement confers a right of audit, of information, or an escalation route, that right is exercised on reasonable prior written notice, during normal business hours, and without unreasonable disruption to the other Party's business. A Party exercising such a right shall treat what it learns as confidential information under this Agreement, and shall bear its own costs unless the audit discloses a material discrepancy, in which case the audited Party shall bear the reasonable cost of the audit and shall correct the discrepancy within thirty (30) days.

Each Party (the "Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other Party and its directors, officers, employees, and authorised representatives (each an "Indemnified Party") from and against any loss, liability, cost, or expense arising from that Party's breach of this Agreement, breach of confidentiality, infringement or misappropriation of intellectual property rights, negligence, wilful misconduct, or any related third-party claim. The conduct of any claim to which this indemnity applies shall be governed as follows:
(a) the Indemnified Party shall notify the Indemnifying Party in writing as soon as reasonably practicable after becoming aware of a claim for which indemnity is sought, giving reasonable particulars of the claim; a delay in giving notice shall reduce the Indemnifying Party's liability only to the extent it is actually prejudiced by that delay
(b) the Indemnifying Party may, on written notice, assume conduct of the defence of the claim at its own cost using legal advisers reasonably acceptable to the Indemnified Party, and the Indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation, access to relevant records, and assistance at the Indemnifying Party's cost
(c) the Indemnifying Party shall not settle or compromise a claim on terms that impose a non-indemnified liability, an admission of wrongdoing, or an ongoing restriction on the Indemnified Party without that Party's prior written consent, and the Indemnified Party shall not settle or compromise a claim without prior consultation with the Indemnifying Party except where urgent action is reasonably required to mitigate loss
(d) the Indemnified Party shall take reasonable steps to mitigate its loss, and the indemnity shall not extend to loss to the extent caused or increased by the Indemnified Party's own breach, negligence, or failure to mitigate
(e) recovery under this indemnity shall be reduced by any amount actually recovered by the Indemnified Party from insurance or from a third party in respect of the same loss, so that the Indemnified Party is not compensated twice for the same loss

clauses.name: Dispute Resolution — Negotiation, Mediation and Arbitration
clauses.text:
Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall first be attempted to be resolved amicably between the Parties. If the dispute remains unresolved within fifteen (15) days of written notice, it shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted by a sole arbitrator jointly appointed by the Parties and, failing agreement within fifteen (15) days of a written request, the arbitrator shall be appointed in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted on the following terms:
(a) The seat of arbitration shall be Pune, Maharashtra, and the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive supervisory jurisdiction over the arbitration.
(b) Hearings may be held at Pune, Maharashtra or, where the arbitrator so directs or the Parties agree, by video conference.
(c) The arbitral tribunal shall consist of a sole arbitrator, and the proceedings and the award shall be in the English language.
(d) The award shall be in writing, shall state the reasons on which it is based, and shall be final and binding on the Parties.
(e) The arbitrator shall determine the costs of the arbitration, including the fees and expenses of the arbitrator and the reasonable legal costs of the Parties, in accordance with Section 31A of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
(f) Nothing in this clause prevents a Party from applying to a competent court for interim measures of protection under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, before or during the arbitral proceedings.

drafting_directives: Treat the intake as instructions about legal meaning and clause placement, not as placeholder text to paste mechanically.
Use a formal document opening with a clear title, an execution line stating place and date where supported by the intake, and a properly introduced party block before the operative clauses.
Use concise but meaningful recitals where appropriate so the factual background and commercial purpose are clear before the operative clauses begin.
Draft substantive numbered clauses with enough legal detail to feel complete and transaction-ready, instead of producing skeletal one-line clauses.
Where the document type or clause structure supports it, define key business and legal terms before relying on those terms later in the document.

Where the intake contains specifications, deliverable lists, payment breakups, technical requirements, or compliance details, present them in structured schedule-style language or clearly itemized subparts.
Use a complete execution block with proper signatory language, capacity references, and signature placeholders suited to the parties' legal form.
Introduce the parties once in full legal style, then keep their role labels and naming consistent throughout the document.
Reflect commencement, duration, renewal, and termination mechanics in the term and termination clauses rather than scattering them randomly.
Translate commercial numbers into clear payment, invoicing, tax, and consideration mechanics.
Express scope, deliverables, milestones, acceptance, and support as operative obligations with clear completion logic.

CORE_IDENTITY_001.title: Parties and Recitals

CORE_PURPOSE_001.title: Purpose of Agreement
CORE_PURPOSE_001.text: The purpose of this Agreement is to set out the terms on which the Client engages the Service Provider to perform the agreed services and associated deliverables described in this Agreement.

CORE_DEFINITIONS_001.title: Definitions
CORE_DEFINITIONS_001.text:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings set out below, and cognate expressions shall be construed accordingly:
(a) "Agreement" means this Agreement together with its schedules, annexures, written amendments, and other documents expressly incorporated by reference.
(b) "Effective Date" means 1 September 2026.
(c) "Services" means design, development, testing, deployment and twelve months of maintenance of a customer-facing ordering application.
(d) "Deliverables" means a working web application, its source code repository, deployment scripts, administrator documentation and two training sessions for operational staff.
(e) "Affiliate" means in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of an entity, or the power to direct its management and policies, whether through ownership of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise.
(f) "Applicable Law" means all statutes, enactments, ordinances, rules, regulations, notifications, circulars, guidelines, policies, directions, judgments, decrees, and orders of any Government Authority having the force of law in India, as in force from time to time and as amended, consolidated, re-enacted, or replaced.
(g) "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday, or a day declared to be a public holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 in the State in which this Agreement is executed, on which scheduled commercial banks are open for normal banking business in that State.
(h) "Force Majeure Event" means any event or circumstance beyond the reasonable control of the affected Party which prevents or materially impedes the performance of its obligations, including act of God, fire, flood, earthquake, cyclone, epidemic, pandemic, lockdown or other restriction imposed by order of a Government Authority, war, hostilities, act of terrorism, riot, civil commotion, strike or other industrial action not confined to the affected Party's own workforce, failure of public utilities or telecommunications infrastructure, and any change in Applicable Law that renders performance unlawful.
(i) "Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and continuing until this Agreement expires or is terminated in accordance with its terms.
(j) "Confidential Information" means all non-public, proprietary, commercially sensitive, technical, financial, business, strategic, operational, customer, vendor, and personnel information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party, in oral, written, visual, digital, or any other form, whether or not marked as confidential, which is designated as confidential or which by its nature ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential, together with all copies, notes, analyses, and derivative materials containing or derived from it.
A term defined in this clause bears that meaning wherever it appears in this Agreement in capitalised form, including in the recitals, the schedules, and any annexure, unless the context otherwise requires.

CORE_INTERPRETATION_001.title: Interpretation
CORE_INTERPRETATION_001.text:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) headings and titles are inserted for convenience only and shall not affect interpretation
(b) words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa, and words importing a gender include every gender
(c) the words "including", "includes", and similar expressions shall be construed as illustrative and not exhaustive
(d) references to any law, statute, rule, regulation, or governmental direction include all amendments, consolidations, re-enactments, and subordinate legislation made thereunder from time to time
(e) any schedule, annexure, appendix, or statement expressly incorporated into this Agreement shall form part of this Agreement, and in the event of inconsistency, the more specific commercial or technical provision shall prevail over the more general provision to the extent of that inconsistency

CORE_RELATIONSHIP_OF_PARTIES_001.title: Relationship of Parties
CORE_RELATIONSHIP_OF_PARTIES_001.text:
The Parties acknowledge and agree that the relationship created by this Agreement is that of independent contracting parties and not of employer and employee, partnership, joint venture, agency, or fiduciary relationship.
(a) neither Party shall hold itself out as having authority to bind the other, and neither Party shall incur any obligation, liability, or expense on behalf of the other, without that other Party's prior written authority
(b) each Party shall be solely responsible for the wages, statutory benefits, provident fund, gratuity, and social security contributions of its own personnel, and for its own taxes, duties, returns, and statutory filings arising in connection with this Agreement
(c) the personnel deployed by a Party shall at all times remain under that Party's direction, supervision, and control, and shall not be treated as employees or workmen of the other Party for the purposes of any labour, industrial, or social-security legislation
(d) each Party shall indemnify the other against any claim, demand, or proceeding brought by its own personnel, or by any authority on their behalf, which asserts an employment or engagement relationship with that other Party

EMP_NON_SOLICITATION_001.title: Non-Solicitation
EMP_NON_SOLICITATION_001.text: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months following its termination or expiry, neither the Client nor the Service Provider shall, directly or indirectly, solicit, induce, recruit, or encourage any employee, personnel member, independent contractor, or key representative of the other Party to terminate their engagement with such other Party or to enter into any employment or engagement with the soliciting Party or any of its affiliates, without the prior written consent of the other Party.

SERVICE_PAYMENT_001.title: Service Payment Terms
SERVICE_PAYMENT_001.text: In consideration of the Services rendered under this Agreement, the Client shall pay the Service Provider fees of ₹3 (Rupees Three Only). Payment shall be made in accordance with the following payment terms: list price less a 15 percent trade discount, invoiced monthly and payable within 30 days of a valid tax invoice. All invoices shall be raised in Indian Rupees as valid GST-compliant tax invoices and shall specify the Service Provider GSTIN 27AABFB2345F1ZW, invoice date, description of the relevant services or deliverables, taxable value, applicable GST amount, place of supply, and recipient GSTIN 27AAACA1234C1ZG where required. In the event of delayed payment beyond the agreed due date, the Service Provider shall be entitled to charge simple interest at the rate of eighteen percent (18%) per annum on the outstanding amount from the due date until the date of actual payment. All payments shall be made by electronic transfer to the bank account designated by the Service Provider in writing.

SERVICE_IMPLIED_SERVICES_001.title: Services Not Expressly Described
SERVICE_IMPLIED_SERVICES_001.text: Where a service, function or responsibility is not expressly described in this Agreement or in a Statement of Work but is reasonably necessary for the proper performance of the Services, it shall be treated as included within the Services and shall be performed at no additional charge, to the same extent and in the same manner as if it had been expressly described. This Clause does not oblige the Service Provider to absorb a material increase in its costs: where the Service Provider considers that performing such a service would materially increase its costs, it shall notify the Client in writing before incurring them and the Parties shall deal with the matter under the change procedure. A failure to give that notice before incurring the costs waives any claim to be paid for them.

SERVICE_SLA_001.title: Service Level Agreement
SERVICE_SLA_001.text: The Service Provider shall meet the following service levels and performance standards under this Agreement: 99.5 per cent monthly uptime measured excluding scheduled maintenance, with a first response to a critical incident within one hour. If the Service Provider fails to meet a material service level, the Client shall be entitled to require a remediation plan, reasonable corrective action, and such service credits or other contractual remedies as are expressly stated in this Agreement. If delay is attributable to the Service Provider, the Client shall be entitled to the following delay remedies: A service credit of two per cent of the monthly fee for each full day of delay, capped at fifteen per cent of the monthly fee. The Service Provider shall also provide timely performance reporting reasonably necessary to verify compliance with these service levels.

SERVICE_KEY_PERSONNEL_001.title: Key Personnel and Resources
SERVICE_KEY_PERSONNEL_001.text: The individuals identified as key personnel in a Statement of Work shall be assigned to the Services for the period it states, and the Service Provider shall not remove or reassign any of them except on death, illness, resignation, dismissal or the Client's written consent. Where a key person must be replaced, the Service Provider shall propose a replacement of at least equivalent skill and experience, shall give the Client a reasonable opportunity to object on reasonable grounds, and shall bear the cost of familiarising the replacement.

SERVICE_SCOPE_001.title: Scope of Services
SERVICE_SCOPE_001.text:
The Service Provider shall provide the following services under this Agreement: Design, development, testing, deployment and twelve months of maintenance of a customer-facing ordering application.
The Service Provider shall perform the services with reasonable skill, care, and diligence, in accordance with the scope described above and with the standard of skill and care reasonably expected of a competent provider of comparable services. The following support, maintenance, or post-delivery obligations shall also apply: Bug fixes and security patches for twelve months from acceptance, with support available on working days between 9:00 a.m. And 6:00 p.m. The Parties acknowledge that the service scope is expected to culminate in the delivery of the outputs, work product, and reporting items expressly identified in this Agreement. The services shall be measured against the following acceptance, review, or completion standard: Each deliverable is accepted when it passes the agreed test cases in a staging environment and acceptance is confirmed in writing within ten working days of delivery. Any material expansion or variation of the service scope, timeline, or output expectations shall require prior written agreement between the Parties, including any corresponding commercial adjustment where applicable.

MSA_SOW_MECHANISM_001.title: Statements of Work
MSA_SOW_MECHANISM_001.text: The Parties may from time to time execute one or more statements of work under this Agreement (each, a 'Statement of Work' or 'SOW'). Each SOW shall describe the services to be performed, including Design, development, testing, deployment and twelve months of maintenance of a customer-facing ordering application. , and shall specify the scope, deliverables, timelines, fees, invoicing schedule, acceptance criteria, and any service levels applicable to that engagement. Each SOW shall be executed in writing by authorised representatives of both Parties and shall, upon execution, be deemed incorporated into and governed by the terms of this Agreement. No SOW shall be effective unless it expressly references this Agreement. Each SOW constitutes a separate contract between the Parties, and termination or expiry of one SOW shall not, of itself, affect any other SOW then in force. Changes to an executed SOW shall be made only through a written change order signed by both Parties.

MSA_ORDER_OF_PRECEDENCE_001.title: Order of Precedence
MSA_ORDER_OF_PRECEDENCE_001.text: In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the terms of this Agreement and the terms of any Statement of Work, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail, except where the Statement of Work expressly identifies the specific clause of this Agreement that it intends to vary and states that it takes precedence, in which case the variation shall apply solely to that Statement of Work. In the event of any conflict between a Statement of Work and any purchase order, invoice, or other administrative document, the Statement of Work shall prevail. Pre-printed or standard terms appearing on either Party's purchase orders, acknowledgements, or invoices shall have no legal effect.

MSA_SUBCONTRACTING_001.title: Subcontracting
MSA_SUBCONTRACTING_001.text: The Service Provider shall not subcontract the whole or any part of the Services without the Client's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld where the proposed subcontractor is competent and willing to be bound by terms no less protective than these. Consent is not required for the use of the Service Provider's own affiliates, of which the Service Provider shall give the Client not less than thirty (30) days' written notice. The Service Provider shall satisfy itself of the suitability of every subcontractor before engaging it, and shall procure that each is bound in writing to the obligations of confidentiality, data protection and compliance with law set out in this Agreement. Subcontracting does not transfer any obligation: the Service Provider remains liable to the Client for the acts and omissions of every subcontractor as though they were its own, and nothing in a subcontract creates any contractual relationship between the Client and the subcontractor or any obligation on the Client to pay it.

SERVICE_CUSTOMER_DEPENDENCIES_001.title: Client Dependencies
SERVICE_CUSTOMER_DEPENDENCIES_001.text: The Client shall provide, in good time, the access, information, decisions, facilities, systems and personnel that this Agreement or a Statement of Work identifies as the Client's responsibility, and any other cooperation the Service Provider reasonably requires and requests in writing in order to perform. A failure by the Client to do so is not of itself a breach of this Agreement; but to the extent and for so long as it actually prevents or impairs performance, the Service Provider is relieved from the affected obligation, from any service level measured against it and from liability for the resulting delay, provided the Service Provider (a) notifies the Client in writing promptly on becoming aware, (b) continues to perform everything unaffected, and (c) takes reasonable steps to mitigate. Anything not identified as the Client's responsibility is the Service Provider's.

CORE_CONFIDENTIALITY_001.title: Confidentiality Obligation
CORE_CONFIDENTIALITY_001.text: The Client and the Service Provider shall each keep confidential all Confidential Information disclosed by the other in connection with this Agreement and shall use such Confidential Information solely for the performance or enjoyment of rights under this Agreement. Neither Party shall disclose Confidential Information to any third party except to its employees, professional advisers, auditors, or subcontractors who have a strict need to know the same and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those contained herein, or where disclosure is required by applicable law, stock exchange regulation, or order of a competent court or authority. Each Party shall exercise at least reasonable care to protect the other Party's Confidential Information and shall, upon termination or written request, promptly return or securely destroy the Confidential Information of the other Party except to the extent retention is required by law or bona fide internal record-keeping policies.

IP_OWNERSHIP_001.title: Intellectual Property Ownership
IP_OWNERSHIP_001.text: All deliverables, work product, inventions, developments, documents, reports, source code, designs, materials, discoveries, and other intellectual property created, conceived, authored, or reduced to practice in the course of performing this Agreement for the Client shall vest exclusively in the Client from creation, and to the extent any such rights do not automatically vest by operation of law, the Service Provider hereby irrevocably assigns, and shall procure the assignment of, all such rights to the Client. The Service Provider shall retain ownership only of pre-existing intellectual property, general know-how, and reusable tools that are not specific to the Client, but grants the Client a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use any such background materials to the extent embedded in or necessary to use the deliverables.

SERVICE_WARRANTY_001.title: Service Warranty
SERVICE_WARRANTY_001.text: The Service Provider warrants that the Services and all Deliverables shall be performed with reasonable skill, care, diligence, and professional competence and shall materially conform to the scope of Services and the deliverables described in this Agreement. For clarity, conformity shall be tested against the following completion or acceptance standard: Each deliverable is accepted when it passes the agreed test cases in a staging environment and acceptance is confirmed in writing within ten working days of delivery. If any Service or Deliverable is found during the warranty period to be materially defective, incomplete, non-conforming, or not in accordance with this Agreement, the Service Provider shall, at its own cost and within a commercially reasonable time, correct, re-perform, update, or replace the affected Service or Deliverable. The warranty period for this clause shall be 24 months. Post-warranty support, maintenance, or additional support obligations shall operate in accordance with the following arrangement: Bug fixes and security patches for twelve months from acceptance, with support available on working days between 9:00 a.m. And 6:00 p.m.

CORE_REPRESENTATIONS_001.text:
Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party, as at the date of this Agreement, that:
(a) it is duly incorporated, registered, or otherwise validly constituted under the laws of India, and is validly existing and in good standing
(b) it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform the obligations undertaken by it, and has taken all corporate, partnership, or other internal action required to authorise its execution and performance
(c) this Agreement has been duly executed by a person authorised to bind it, and constitutes its legal, valid, and binding obligation, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms
(d) its execution and performance of this Agreement does not and will not breach its constitutional documents, any judgment or order binding on it, or any agreement to which it is a party
(e) every consent, approval, licence, registration, and authorisation required for it to enter into and perform this Agreement has been obtained and is in force
(f) no insolvency, winding-up, or similar proceeding has been commenced or, so far as it is aware, threatened against it
These representations and warranties are given on the date of this Agreement and are deemed repeated on each date on which an obligation falls due under this Agreement, by reference to the facts then subsisting.

CORE_COMPLIANCE_WITH_LAW_001.title: Compliance with Law
CORE_COMPLIANCE_WITH_LAW_001.text:
Each Party shall, in performing its obligations under this Agreement, comply with all Applicable Law, and shall obtain and maintain at its own cost every registration, licence, permission, consent, and approval necessary for it to perform those obligations lawfully.
(a) neither Party shall offer, promise, give, request, or accept any undue advantage, whether directly or through a third party, in order to obtain or retain business or any improper advantage, and each Party shall comply with the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and with any other anti-bribery legislation applicable to it
(b) each Party shall comply with the applicable tax, labour, environmental, and data protection legislation in force from time to time, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where personal data is processed under this Agreement
(c) each Party shall promptly notify the other if it becomes aware of any circumstance that would make performance of this Agreement unlawful, or that would place the other Party in breach of Applicable Law
(d) a Party shall not be required to do anything under this Agreement that would cause it to breach Applicable Law, and shall consult with the other Party in good faith to agree a lawful alternative before treating performance as excused

CORE_GOVERNANCE_PROTECTIONS_001.title: Audit, Information and Escalation
CORE_GOVERNANCE_PROTECTIONS_001.text: Each Party shall keep true and complete records of its performance under this Agreement, and shall preserve them for the period a law in force requires or for three (3) years from the end of the financial year to which they relate, whichever is longer. Audit rights shall operate as follows: Compliance may be audited once in any twelve-month period, on fifteen days' written notice, during business hours and at the auditing party's own cost. Information rights and periodic reporting shall operate as follows: Monthly management accounts within twenty-one days of month end, audited accounts within ninety days of the financial year end, and an annual budget before the year begins. Operational escalation shall follow this mechanism before formal remedies are invoked where commercially reasonable: 10. The following additional protection clauses shall also apply: A twelve-month non-solicitation of the disclosing party's employees and a prohibition on reverse engineering any disclosed prototype. Where this Agreement confers a right of audit, of information, or an escalation route, that right is exercised on reasonable prior written notice, during normal business hours, and without unreasonable disruption to the other Party's business. A Party exercising such a right shall treat what it learns as confidential information under this Agreement, and shall bear its own costs unless the audit discloses a material discrepancy, in which case the audited Party shall bear the reasonable cost of the audit and shall correct the discrepancy within thirty (30) days.

MSA_GOVERNANCE_BODY_001.title: Governance and Escalation
MSA_GOVERNANCE_BODY_001.text: Each Party shall appoint a representative who is the principal point of contact for the Services and who has authority to take day-to-day decisions on that Party's behalf, and shall notify the other in writing of any change. The representatives shall meet at least once a quarter to review performance, changes and any matter either Party raises. A matter the representatives cannot resolve within fifteen (15) days shall be referred to a senior officer of each Party, who shall meet within a further fifteen (15) days. Decisions of the representatives bind the Parties only where recorded in writing and signed by both; nothing said at a meeting varies this Agreement unless it is recorded as an amendment. This Clause does not prevent either Party from seeking urgent interim relief, from referring a dispute to arbitration once the escalation periods have expired, or from exercising a right of termination that has accrued.

CORE_INDEMNITY_001.title: Indemnity
CORE_INDEMNITY_001.text:
Each Party (the "Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other Party and its directors, officers, employees, and authorised representatives (each an "Indemnified Party") from and against any loss, liability, cost, or expense arising from that Party's breach of this Agreement, breach of confidentiality, infringement or misappropriation of intellectual property rights, negligence, wilful misconduct, or any related third-party claim. The conduct of any claim to which this indemnity applies shall be governed as follows:
(a) the Indemnified Party shall notify the Indemnifying Party in writing as soon as reasonably practicable after becoming aware of a claim for which indemnity is sought, giving reasonable particulars of the claim; a delay in giving notice shall reduce the Indemnifying Party's liability only to the extent it is actually prejudiced by that delay
(b) the Indemnifying Party may, on written notice, assume conduct of the defence of the claim at its own cost using legal advisers reasonably acceptable to the Indemnified Party, and the Indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation, access to relevant records, and assistance at the Indemnifying Party's cost
(c) the Indemnifying Party shall not settle or compromise a claim on terms that impose a non-indemnified liability, an admission of wrongdoing, or an ongoing restriction on the Indemnified Party without that Party's prior written consent, and the Indemnified Party shall not settle or compromise a claim without prior consultation with the Indemnifying Party except where urgent action is reasonably required to mitigate loss
(d) the Indemnified Party shall take reasonable steps to mitigate its loss, and the indemnity shall not extend to loss to the extent caused or increased by the Indemnified Party's own breach, negligence, or failure to mitigate
(e) recovery under this indemnity shall be reduced by any amount actually recovered by the Indemnified Party from insurance or from a third party in respect of the same loss, so that the Indemnified Party is not compensated twice for the same loss

CORE_LIMITATION_LIABILITY_001.title: Limitation of Liability
CORE_LIMITATION_LIABILITY_001.text:
Subject to the carve-outs below, the aggregate liability of either Party under or in connection with this Agreement, whether arising in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty, restitution, or otherwise, shall not exceed the aggregate fees paid or payable under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, which on the consideration and term recorded in this Agreement the Parties presently estimate at approximately ₹2 (Rupees Two Only).
(a) neither Party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive, exemplary, or consequential loss, or for loss of profits, loss of anticipated savings, loss of opportunity, loss of goodwill, or loss of business, in each case whether or not that loss was foreseeable at the date of this Agreement
(b) the limitations and exclusions in this clause shall not apply to liability arising from fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, wilful misconduct, breach of the confidentiality provisions of this Agreement, deliberate infringement or misappropriation of intellectual property rights, a Party's payment obligations in respect of amounts properly due, or any liability which cannot lawfully be excluded or limited
(c) the cap in this clause applies to the aggregate of all claims taken together and not to each claim separately, and each Party's liability shall be reduced to the extent that the loss was caused or contributed to by the other Party's own breach, negligence, or failure to mitigate
(d) the Parties confirm that the allocation of risk recorded in this clause is a genuine and reasonable commercial apportionment, negotiated in light of the consideration payable under this Agreement, and that each Party has had the opportunity to price and insure the risk it bears

CORE_INDEMNITY_PROCEDURE_001.title: Conduct of Indemnified Claims
CORE_INDEMNITY_PROCEDURE_001.text: Where a Party entitled to be indemnified under this Agreement becomes aware of a claim for which it may seek indemnity, it shall notify the indemnifying Party in writing as soon as reasonably practicable, giving the particulars then known to it, and shall give the indemnifying Party such assistance in the defence as it reasonably requests, at the indemnifying Party's cost. The indemnifying Party may take over the conduct of the defence by written notice, and shall then conduct it diligently and keep the indemnified Party informed; the indemnified Party may participate at its own cost through advisers of its own choosing. If the indemnifying Party does not take over the defence within a reasonable time, the indemnified Party may defend the claim as it thinks fit and recover the cost of doing so. Neither Party shall admit liability, settle or compromise a claim without the other's written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and no settlement shall be made that does not release the indemnified Party unconditionally. The indemnified Party shall take the steps the indemnifying Party reasonably requires to mitigate the loss, and shall account to the indemnifying Party for any recovery it makes in respect of the same loss. A delay in notification does not defeat the indemnity except to the extent the indemnifying Party is actually prejudiced by it.

SERVICE_EXPENSES_001.title: Service Expenses
SERVICE_EXPENSES_001.text:
The following expense reimbursement arrangement shall apply under this Agreement: Travel, accommodation and client entertainment approved in advance, reimbursed against original receipts within thirty days of a claim. Any reimbursable expense claimed by the Service Provider shall be supported by reasonable documentary evidence and, unless the stated policy provides otherwise, shall require the prior written approval of the Client. In addition:
(a) a claim for reimbursement shall be made within thirty (30) days of the expense being incurred, supported by the original invoice or receipt and a short statement of the purpose for which it was incurred
(b) the Client shall pay an approved claim within thirty (30) days of receiving it, together with the next payment falling due under this Agreement where that is more convenient
(c) where the expense attracts GST and the Service Provider is registered, the claim shall be raised as a GST-compliant tax invoice so that input credit is not lost
(d) expenses of a personal nature, fines and penalties, and any cost arising from the Service Provider's own delay, breach, or failure to obtain approval are not reimbursable
(e) the Client may decline a claim that was not approved in advance where approval was required, and shall give reasons in writing for doing so

CORE_TERM_001.title: Term of Agreement
CORE_TERM_001.text: This Agreement shall commence on 1 September 2026 (the "Effective Date") and, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement, shall remain in force for 24 months from the Effective Date. Upon expiry of the initial term of 24 months, this Agreement may be renewed or extended only on the following basis: 24 months.

CORE_FORCE_MAJEURE_001.title: Force Majeure
CORE_FORCE_MAJEURE_001.text:
Neither Party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement to the extent that the failure or delay is caused by a Force Majeure Event, provided that the affected Party complies with this clause. An obligation to pay an amount already due and payable shall not be excused by a Force Majeure Event.
(a) the affected Party shall notify the other Party in writing within seven (7) days of becoming aware of the Force Majeure Event, describing the event, the obligations affected, and its anticipated duration, and shall keep the other Party reasonably informed of material developments
(b) the affected Party's obligations shall be suspended for so long as the Force Majeure Event continues, and the time for performance shall be extended by the period of suspension
(c) the affected Party shall use reasonable endeavours to mitigate the effect of the Force Majeure Event and to resume full performance as soon as reasonably practicable, and shall notify the other Party promptly upon the event ceasing
(d) if a Force Majeure Event continues for a continuous period exceeding sixty (60) days, either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other, without liability except in respect of obligations accrued before the date of termination

SERVICE_TERMINATION_001.title: Termination
SERVICE_TERMINATION_001.text: This Agreement may be terminated (a) by either Client or Service Provider for convenience upon 3 days' prior written notice to the other Party; (b) by either Party with immediate effect if the other Party commits a material breach of this Agreement and, where such breach is capable of remedy, fails to cure it within 3 days after receipt of written notice requiring the same to be remedied; (c) by either Party with immediate effect if the other Party becomes insolvent, is wound up, enters into a composition with creditors, or ceases to carry on business. Upon termination or expiry, each Party shall remain liable for accrued payment obligations and for all obligations which by their nature are intended to survive, including confidentiality, ownership of intellectual property, indemnity, limitation of liability, dispute resolution, governing law and jurisdiction, notices, and any accrued rights or remedies. Upon termination: (i) the Client shall pay all undisputed fees accrued up to the date of termination; (ii) the Service Provider shall deliver all work product, work-in-progress, and data to the Client; and (iii) both Parties shall return or securely destroy all Confidential Information of the other Party.

SERVICE_TERMINATION_CONVENIENCE_001.title: Termination for Convenience
SERVICE_TERMINATION_CONVENIENCE_001.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time, without cause, by giving the other Party not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Upon such termination, the Client shall pay the Service Provider for all Services satisfactorily rendered up to the effective date of termination, together with any non-cancellable costs reasonably incurred. Neither Party shall be liable to the other for damages, compensation, or loss of anticipated profits solely by reason of termination for convenience exercised in accordance with this clause.

CORE_SURVIVAL_001.title: Survival
CORE_SURVIVAL_001.text: Expiry or termination of this Agreement shall not affect any right, remedy, obligation, or liability of a Party that has accrued as at the date of expiry or termination, and shall not affect the coming into force or the continuance in force of any provision which is expressly, or by implication, intended to come into force or to continue in force on or after that date. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the provisions of this Agreement relating to confidentiality, ownership of intellectual property, indemnity, limitation of liability, dispute resolution, governing law and jurisdiction, notices, and this clause shall survive expiry or termination and shall continue to bind the Parties.

CORE_NOTICE_001.title: Notices
CORE_NOTICE_001.text:
Any notice, consent, approval, demand, or other communication required or permitted under this Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be sent to the address of the recipient Party set out in this clause, or to such other address as that Party may notify under this clause. A communication shall be deemed to have been received as follows:
(a) if delivered by hand, on the date of delivery where delivered on a Business Day before 5:00 p.m. Local time, and otherwise on the next Business Day
(b) if sent by registered post or speed post with acknowledgement due, on the date recorded on the acknowledgement or on the fifth (5th) Business Day after posting, whichever is earlier
(c) if sent by a reputed courier service, on the second (2nd) Business Day after the date of dispatch
(d) if sent by electronic mail to the address notified for that purpose, on the date of transmission where sent on a Business Day before 5:00 p.m. Local time and no delivery-failure notification is received, and otherwise on the next Business Day
A Party changing its address or electronic mail address for notices shall give the other Party not less than seven (7) days' prior written notice of the change, and until that notice is given a communication sent to the last notified address shall be validly given.

CORE_ASSIGNMENT_001.title: Assignment
CORE_ASSIGNMENT_001.text:
Neither Party shall assign, transfer, charge, subcontract, or otherwise deal with all or any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
(a) a Party may, on written notice to the other Party, assign or novate this Agreement to an Affiliate, or to a successor in title to substantially the whole of the business or assets to which this Agreement relates, provided that the assignee agrees in writing to be bound by this Agreement
(b) any purported assignment, transfer, or charge in breach of this clause shall be void and of no effect
(c) this Agreement shall be binding on, and shall enure for the benefit of, each Party and its permitted successors and assigns

CORE_AMENDMENT_001.title: Amendment
CORE_AMENDMENT_001.text: No amendment, variation, or modification of this Agreement shall be valid or binding unless it is recorded in writing, expressly refers to this Agreement, and is signed by or on behalf of each Party by a person duly authorised for that purpose. No course of dealing between the Parties, exchange of correspondence, or oral assurance shall operate to vary this Agreement. Where an amendment attracts stamp duty or compulsory registration under Applicable Law, that amendment shall be duly stamped and, where required, registered before either Party relies upon it.

CORE_WAIVER_001.title: Waiver
CORE_WAIVER_001.text: No failure, delay, or indulgence by a Party in exercising any right, power, or remedy under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver of that right, power, or remedy, nor shall any single or partial exercise of it preclude any further exercise of that or any other right, power, or remedy. A waiver of any right, power, or remedy under this Agreement is effective only if it is given in writing and signed by or on behalf of the waiving Party, and shall not be treated as a waiver of any subsequent breach or default. The rights and remedies provided under this Agreement are cumulative and are not exclusive of any rights or remedies available under Applicable Law.

CORE_SEVERABILITY_001.title: Severability
CORE_SEVERABILITY_001.text: If any provision or part-provision of this Agreement is or becomes invalid, illegal, or unenforceable under Applicable Law, it shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, legal, and enforceable, and if such modification is not possible, the provision or part-provision concerned shall be deemed deleted. Any modification to, or deletion of, a provision or part-provision under this clause shall not affect the validity and enforceability of the remainder of this Agreement, which shall continue in full force and effect. Where a provision is modified or deleted under this clause, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to substitute a valid and enforceable provision that achieves, so far as possible, the commercial result originally intended.

CORE_ENTIRE_AGREEMENT_001.title: Entire Agreement
CORE_ENTIRE_AGREEMENT_001.text:
This Agreement, together with its schedules and annexures, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties in relation to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements, arrangements, understandings, term sheets, proposals, quotations, and representations, whether written or oral, relating to that subject matter.
(a) each Party acknowledges that in entering into this Agreement it does not rely on, and shall have no remedy in respect of, any statement, representation, assurance, or warranty that is not expressly set out in this Agreement
(b) nothing in this clause shall exclude or limit any liability for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or operate to exclude any term implied by Applicable Law which cannot lawfully be excluded
(c) where any purchase order, invoice, acknowledgement, portal terms, or other standard-form document issued by either Party contains terms inconsistent with this Agreement, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail unless the Parties expressly agree otherwise in a written amendment executed in accordance with this Agreement

CORE_FURTHER_ASSURANCE_001.title: Further Assurance
CORE_FURTHER_ASSURANCE_001.text: Each Party shall, at the reasonable request and cost of the requesting Party, promptly execute and deliver such further documents, instruments, declarations, forms, and writings, and do or procure to be done all such further acts and things, as may be reasonably necessary or expedient to give full force and effect to this Agreement and to perfect, record, or protect the rights, title, interests, and obligations created or intended to be created under it, including any filings, registrations, or intimations required to be made before any statutory or regulatory authority.

CORE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_001.title: Dispute Resolution Mechanism
CORE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_001.text:
Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall first be attempted to be resolved amicably between the Parties. If the dispute remains unresolved within fifteen (15) days of written notice, it shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted by a sole arbitrator jointly appointed by the Parties and, failing agreement within fifteen (15) days of a written request, the arbitrator shall be appointed in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted on the following terms:
(a) The seat of arbitration shall be Pune, Maharashtra, and the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive supervisory jurisdiction over the arbitration.
(b) Hearings may be held at Pune, Maharashtra or, where the arbitrator so directs or the Parties agree, by video conference.
(c) The arbitral tribunal shall consist of a sole arbitrator, and the proceedings and the award shall be in the English language.
(d) The award shall be in writing, shall state the reasons on which it is based, and shall be final and binding on the Parties.
(e) The arbitrator shall determine the costs of the arbitration, including the fees and expenses of the arbitrator and the reasonable legal costs of the Parties, in accordance with Section 31A of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
(f) Nothing in this clause prevents a Party from applying to a competent court for interim measures of protection under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, before or during the arbitral proceedings.

CORE_GOVERNING_LAW_001.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
CORE_GOVERNING_LAW_001.text:
This Agreement, and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it, its subject matter or its formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims), shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, and where local procedural, registration, or stamp matters are relevant, as applied in the State of Maharashtra.
(a) subject to the dispute resolution provisions of this Agreement, the competent courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, and each Party irrevocably submits to that jurisdiction
(b) each Party waives any objection to that forum on the ground of inconvenient forum or that proceedings have been brought in an inappropriate court
(c) the rules of private international law shall not apply to the extent they would result in the application of the law of any jurisdiction other than India
(d) nothing in this clause shall prevent either Party from applying to any court of competent jurisdiction for interim or protective relief, including injunctive relief, to preserve its rights pending resolution of the dispute

CORE_COUNTERPARTS_001.title: Counterparts and Electronic Execution
CORE_COUNTERPARTS_001.text: This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed and delivered shall constitute an original, and all counterparts taken together shall constitute one and the same instrument. A Party may enter into this Agreement by executing a counterpart and delivering it by electronic mail in portable document format, or by affixing an electronic signature to it. The Parties acknowledge that, under Section 5 of the Information Technology Act, 2000, an electronic signature affixed in the prescribed manner satisfies a requirement of law that information be authenticated by signature, save in respect of the classes of document excluded by the First Schedule to that Act; and where this Agreement or any amendment to it falls within that Schedule, it shall be executed as a physical instrument bearing wet-ink signatures.

CORE_STAMP_AND_COSTS_001.title: Stamp Duty, Registration and Costs
CORE_STAMP_AND_COSTS_001.text:
This Agreement shall be stamped with non-judicial stamp duty of the value payable under the Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, and shall be stamped before or at the time of execution.
Unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing, the stamp duty, registration fees where registration is required under applicable law, and all incidental charges payable in respect of this Agreement shall be borne equally by the Parties, and each Party shall bear its own legal, professional, and advisory costs.
The Parties acknowledge that an instrument which is not duly stamped is inadmissible in evidence until the deficiency in duty, together with any penalty, is made good in accordance with the applicable stamp legislation.

SETTLE_RECITALS_001.title: Recitals
SETTLE_RECITALS_001.text:
WHEREAS:

(c) the Parties, without admitting any liability and solely to avoid the cost, delay and uncertainty of litigation, have agreed to settle all such disputes on the terms recorded below.

CORE_DEFINITIONS_001.title: Definitions
CORE_DEFINITIONS_001.text:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings set out below, and cognate expressions shall be construed accordingly:
(a) "Agreement" means this Agreement together with its schedules, annexures, written amendments, and other documents expressly incorporated by reference.
(b) "Effective Date" means 1 September 2026.
(c) "Applicable Law" means all statutes, enactments, ordinances, rules, regulations, notifications, circulars, guidelines, policies, directions, judgments, decrees, and orders of any Government Authority having the force of law in India, as in force from time to time and as amended, consolidated, re-enacted, or replaced.
(d) "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday, or a day declared to be a public holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 in the State in which this Agreement is executed, on which scheduled commercial banks are open for normal banking business in that State.
(e) "Term" means the period commencing on the Effective Date and continuing until this Agreement expires or is terminated in accordance with its terms.
A term defined in this clause bears that meaning wherever it appears in this Agreement in capitalised form, including in the recitals, the schedules, and any annexure, unless the context otherwise requires.

CORE_INTERPRETATION_001.title: Interpretation
CORE_INTERPRETATION_001.text:
In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) headings and titles are inserted for convenience only and shall not affect interpretation
(b) words importing the singular include the plural and vice versa, and words importing a gender include every gender
(c) the words "including", "includes", and similar expressions shall be construed as illustrative and not exhaustive
(d) references to any law, statute, rule, regulation, or governmental direction include all amendments, consolidations, re-enactments, and subordinate legislation made thereunder from time to time

SETTLE_CONSIDERATION_001.title: Settlement Sum
SETTLE_CONSIDERATION_001.text:
(a) In full and final settlement of all claims described above, the First Party shall pay the Second Party the sum of Rs. 3/- (Rupees Three Lakh only).
(b) The said sum is inclusive of interest, costs and all other claims, and no further sum is payable by either Party to the other in respect of the said disputes.

SETTLE_PAYMENT_001.title: Payment
SETTLE_PAYMENT_001.text:
(a) the said sum shall be paid in three equal monthly instalments, the first falling due thirty days after this Agreement, by electronic transfer to the account notified in writing by the Parties
(b) time is of the essence in respect of payment
(c) the said sum is paid as compensation in settlement of disputed claims and not as consideration for any supply of goods or services, and accordingly no tax invoice shall be raised in respect of it; the Parties' registration particulars are recorded for identification only, being GSTIN 27AABFB2345F1ZW for the Parties and GSTIN 27AAACA1234C1ZG for the paying Party
(d) if any instalment remains unpaid for 3 days after it falls due, the whole of the unpaid balance shall become immediately due and payable, and the releases in this Agreement shall not take effect, or shall cease to have effect, in respect of the claims of the Party not paid
(e) each Party shall bear its own tax liability arising from this settlement, and nothing in this Agreement shifts a statutory liability that the law places on a particular Party

SETTLE_RELEASE_001.title: Mutual Release
SETTLE_RELEASE_001.text:
(a) Subject to payment in full of the said sum, each Party releases and discharges the other from all claims, demands and causes of action arising out of or in connection with the said disputes, whether presently known or not.
(b) This release does not extend to a claim arising out of a breach of this Agreement itself.
(c) This release does not extend to, and nothing in this Agreement shall be read as waiving, any right or remedy that the law does not permit to be waived.
(d) This release does not extend to any claim founded on fraud or on wilful concealment by the Party seeking to rely on it.

SETTLE_CONFIDENTIALITY_001.title: Confidentiality and No Admission
SETTLE_CONFIDENTIALITY_001.text:
(a) The terms of this Agreement are confidential and shall not be disclosed by either Party except to its professional advisers, to a court or tribunal, or where disclosure is required by law or by a regulator.
(b) Nothing in this Agreement, and no negotiation leading to it, is an admission of liability by either Party.
(c) Neither Party shall make any statement disparaging the other in relation to the said disputes.

SETTLE_PROCEEDINGS_001.title: Disposal of Proceedings

(b) Each Party shall sign every document and do every act reasonably required to give effect to limb (a).
(c) Each Party shall bear its own costs of the said proceedings.

clauses.title: Security Safeguards
clauses.text:
The Processor shall take reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach, as Section 8(5) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 requires. Those safeguards shall include, at a minimum, the measures below, which are those prescribed by Rule 6 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025. The Parties adopt them by contract with effect from the date of this Agreement, and record that Rule 6 itself comes into force on 14 May 2027.
(a) Appropriate protection of personal data by encryption, obfuscation, masking, or the use of virtual tokens.
(b) Control over access to the computer resources on which personal data is processed.
(c) Visibility over who accesses personal data, through logs, monitoring, and review, so that an unauthorised access can be detected, investigated, and remedied.
(d) Retention of those logs and of the personal data for a period of one year, unless a longer period is required by law, so that an unauthorised access may be traced.
(e) Measures for the continued processing of personal data in the event of loss of access, including reasonable backups.
(f) Appropriate provision in every contract the Processor enters into with any person it engages, requiring that person to take the same safeguards.
The Processor shall keep these safeguards under review and shall not reduce them during the term of this Agreement.
